name: v0.59.4
body:
Hi everyone,

Apache OpenDAL 0.59.4 is now available.

OpenDAL is an Open Data Access Layer that provides unified access to storage services.

- [Downloads](https://opendal.apache.org/download)
- [Release notes](https://github.com/apache/opendal/releases/tag/v0.59.4)
- [Approved candidate](https://releases.apache.org/vote/opendal/0.59.4-rc.2)
- [Website](https://opendal.apache.org/)

Thanks to everyone who contributed and verified this release.

The Apache OpenDAL community

### Package versions

| Package | Previous | Target | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| core | 0.59.3 | 0.59.4 | Weekly patch |
| integrations/dav-server | 0.7.9 | 0.7.10 | Weekly patch |
| integrations/object_store | 0.60.3 | 0.60.4 | Weekly patch |
| integrations/parquet | 0.10.3 | 0.10.4 | Weekly patch |
| integrations/unftp-sbe | 0.4.9 | 0.4.10 | Weekly patch |
| bindings/c | 0.47.6 | 0.47.7 | Weekly patch |
| bindings/cpp | 0.45.33 | 0.45.34 | Weekly patch |
| bindings/java | 0.50.6 | 0.50.7 | Weekly patch |
| bindings/nodejs | 0.49.11 | 0.49.12 | Weekly patch |
| bindings/python | 0.47.10 | 0.47.11 | Weekly patch |
| bindings/ruby | 0.1.14 | 0.1.15 | Weekly patch |
| bindings/dotnet | 0.2.3 | 0.3.0 | Declared breaking change |

### Breaking changes and migration

#### [#8316](https://github.com/apache/opendal/pull/8316) — `bindings/dotnet`

- Replace `op.ReadAsync(path, token)` with `op.ReadAsync(path, cancellationToken: token)`.
- Replace `op.WriteAsync(path, bytes, token)` with `op.WriteAsync(path, bytes, cancellationToken: token)`.
- Replace `op.StatAsync(path, token)` with `op.StatAsync(path, cancellationToken: token)`.
- Replace `op.ListAsync(path, token)` with `op.ListAsync(path, cancellationToken: token)`.

Calls that already pass options positionally, and calls that pass no token, are unaffected.



<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.59.4 -->

## What's Changed
### Added
* Add `BufferCursor`, an implementation of `Read` + `Seek` for `Buffer` by @trxcllnt in https://github.com/apache/opendal/pull/8320
* feat(bindings/dotnet): add Exists and Check by @Fatorin in https://github.com/apache/opendal/pull/8337
* feat(services/hdfs): add copy support by @hfutatzhanghb in https://github.com/apache/opendal/pull/8332
### Changed
* refactor(bindings/dotnet)!: remove redundant async overloads and simplify Operator by @Fatorin in https://github.com/apache/opendal/pull/8316
* refactor(services/webdav): deprecate enable_conditional_read by @YuangGao in https://github.com/apache/opendal/pull/8314
### Fixed
* fix(core): disable prefetch for concurrent writes and copies by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/apache/opendal/pull/8327
* fix(scripts): show release verification build output by @suyanhanx in https://github.com/apache/opendal/pull/8317
* fix(services/oss): prefer OIDC credentials over ECS metadata by @WenyXu in https://github.com/apache/opendal/pull/8339
* fix(core): normalize paths in Deleter::delete by @yuhao-su in https://github.com/apache/opendal/pull/8352
### Docs
* docs: add Anaconda main installation for Python by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/apache/opendal/pull/8328
### CI
* ci: prepare weekly releases on Thursday UTC by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/apache/opendal/pull/8335
* feat(bindings/dotnet): build and package the linux-arm64 native library by @Fatorin in https://github.com/apache/opendal/pull/8336
### Other Changes
* chore: sync released versions for 0.59.3 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/apache/opendal/pull/8334

## New Contributors
* @yuhao-su made their first contribution in https://github.com/apache/opendal/pull/8352

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/apache/opendal/compare/v0.59.3...v0.59.4
